chunks.arabic_text: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُوسَى اَلْمُتَوَكِّلُ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ اَلْخَزَّازِ قَالَ

translations.en: Muhammad ibn Musa al-Mutawakkil narrated from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Khazzaz who said:

chunks.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ اَلرِّضَا ع يَقُولُ إِنَّ مِمَّنْ يَتَّخِذُ مَوَدَّتَنَا أَهْلَ اَلْبَيْتِ لَمَنْ هُوَ أَشَدُّ لَعْنَةً عَلَى شِيعَتِنَا مِنَ اَلدَّجَّالِ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ يَا اِبْنَ رَسُولِ اَللَّهِ بِمَا ذَا قَالَ بِمُوَالاَةِ أَعْدَائِنَا وَ مُعَادَاةِ أَوْلِيَائِنَا إِنَّهُ إِذَا كَانَ كَذَلِكَ اِخْتَلَطَ اَلْحَقُّ بِالْبَاطِلِ وَ اِشْتَبَهَ اَلْأَمْرُ فَلَمْ يُعْرَفْ مُؤْمِنٌ مِنْ مُنَافِقٍ

translations.en: I heard al-Rida (peace be upon him) saying: 'Among those who claim affection for us, the Ahl al-Bayt, there is one who is more severely cursed by God for our Shia than the Dajjal.' I asked him: 'O son of the Messenger of God, for what reason?' He said: 'By being loyal to our enemies and hostile to our friends. Indeed, when this is the case, the truth becomes mixed with falsehood and the matter becomes confused, so that a believer is not distinguished from a hypocrite.'

en.summary: Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) identifies a subtle form of hypocrisy where superficial loyalty masks active alignment with the Imams' enemies, a condition he deems more perilous than the Dajjal because it obscures the community's internal unity. This scholarly insight highlights the critical Shia concept of *tawqi* (distinction), where the mixing of truth and falsehood prevents the recognition of true believers (*mu'min*) from hypocrites (*munafiq*).
en.seo_question: Why are false claimants of loyalty to the Ahl al-Bayt considered more dangerous than the Dajjal?
